title: A short quantum window uses a legitimate reduced bath generator
statement: For a finite bounded total legitimate time-local generator, maximally mixed reduction R L E yields a CPTP bath reference by a short-step product limit, not equality R exp(tL)E=exp(tRLE). Centered local Delta_e=N_e-Id tensor R N_e E have norm<=2||N_e|| and original system support. Reference intervals are contractions; integrated insertion strength A gives the Dyson support tail exp(A)(eA/K)^K for K>=A. Low-order terms lie in the SPAN of radius-r error modules even for coherent support superpositions; actual positive outside weight is bounded by the remainder and gentle error2sqrt(tail). Physical support radius must be converted through actual BOTH-CSS-sector/dirty/BUSY footprints. The supplied warm completion pays the noncommuting support-cut error against O(N) boundary weight norms; it is not a uniform all-bulk-subset claim or a long waiting theorem.
